info.title: Zenon Network JSON-RPC API
info.description: JSON-RPC 2.0 API of go-zenon. Hand-authored from the pinned source (godoc-verified); examples captured from a live public node. Namespaces covered: ledger, stats, subscribe (websocket), and embedded.{pillar, plasma, token, stake, sentinel, swap, accelerator, spork, htlc, bridge, liquidity}.

methods.name: embedded.accelerator.getAll
methods.summary: Returns one page of every accelerator project, most recently updated first.
methods.description: Returns one page of every accelerator project, in any status, read from contract state at the frontier momentum and enriched with each project's vote breakdown and phases. The full list is sorted by descending last-update timestamp before the page window is cut (the sort is stable, so projects sharing a timestamp keep their storage order), and count is the total number of projects. Unlike most paged methods in this package, pageSize is not capped.

params.name: pageIndex
params.description: 0-based page number.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Number of projects per page; not capped.

result.name: acceleratorProjectList
result.description: One page of projects sorted by descending last-update timestamp; count is the total number of projects.

methods.name: embedded.accelerator.getVoteBreakdown
methods.summary: Returns the tally of pillar votes cast on a project or phase.
methods.description: Returns the tally of pillar votes cast on the project or phase with the given id as of the frontier momentum: total counts every vote including abstentions, while yes and no count only those choices. The id is not validated against the stored projects and phases, so an id nobody has voted on yields zero tallies rather than an error; the method does return ErrDataNonExistent only in the internal case where the breakdown cannot be produced.

params.name: id
params.description: The project or phase id whose votes to tally.

result.name: acceleratorVoteBreakdown
result.description: The vote tally for the id.

methods.name: embedded.accelerator.getPillarVotes
methods.summary: Returns a named pillar's votes on the given project or phase ids.
methods.description: Returns the votes the named pillar has cast on the given project or phase ids as of the frontier momentum, one result per requested hash in the same order. A hash the pillar has not voted on yields a null entry rather than an error; vote values are 0 for yes, 1 for no and 2 for abstain.

params.name: name
params.description: The pillar name whose votes to look up.

params.name: hashes
params.description: The project or phase ids to look up, iterated in order.

result.name: acceleratorPillarVotes

schema.description: One entry per requested hash, in request order; null where the pillar has not voted on that hash.

result.description: The pillar's vote per requested hash, in request order.

methods.name: embedded.bridge.getBridgeInfo
methods.summary: Returns the bridge contract's global state.
methods.description: Returns the contract's global state at the frontier momentum: the administrator address, the compressed and decompressed TSS ECDSA public keys produced by the orchestrator's key-generation ceremony, the allowKeyGen flag, the halt state (halted, unhaltedAt, unhaltDurationInMomentums) and the tssNonce that sequences administrative TSS-signed messages, plus the free-form metadata. Before the state is first written it reads as defaults rather than an error.

result.name: bridgeInfo
result.description: The bridge contract's global state.

methods.name: embedded.bridge.getSecurityInfo
methods.summary: Returns the bridge's guardian and time-challenge security configuration.
methods.description: Returns the time-challenge security configuration of the bridge contract at the frontier momentum: the guardian addresses that can vote in a new administrator during an emergency, their current votes (positionally aligned with the guardians; the zero address means no vote), and the two challenge delays in momentums (administratorDelay for administrator and guardian changes, softDelay for the other protected methods). Before security is initialized it reads as the minimum delays with no guardians.

result.name: securityInfo
result.description: The guardians, their votes and the two challenge delays.

methods.name: embedded.bridge.getOrchestratorInfo
methods.summary: Returns the parameters the orchestrator network operates under.
methods.description: Returns the orchestrator configuration at the frontier momentum: windowSize, the length in momentums of the window within which only one signing ceremony can run; keyGenThreshold, the minimum participants for a key-generation ceremony; confirmationsToFinality, the momentums a wrap request must age before it is signed; estimatedMomentumTime, the assumed seconds per momentum; and allowKeyGenHeight, the height the orchestrator uses as a key-gen reference. Before the state is first written every field reads as 0.

result.name: orchestratorInfo
result.description: The orchestrator parameters.

methods.name: embedded.bridge.getTimeChallengesInfo
methods.summary: Returns the recorded time challenges for the bridge's protected administrator methods.
methods.description: Returns the recorded time challenges for the bridge's protected administrator methods (NominateGuardians, ChangeTssECDSAPubKey, ChangeAdministrator, SetTokenPair). Methods that have never been challenged are omitted, so count is the number of methods with a recorded challenge. A completed challenge keeps its slot with an all-zero ParamsHash. The entry JSON keys are the capitalized Go field names (MethodName, ParamsHash, ChallengeStartHeight).

result.name: timeChallengesInfo
result.description: The recorded time challenges; methods never challenged are omitted.

methods.name: embedded.bridge.getNetworkInfo
methods.summary: Returns the bridged network identified by a network class and chain id.
methods.description: Returns the network registered under networkClass and chainId at the frontier momentum, carrying its name, the bridge contract address on that network, free-form metadata and the token pairs that can cross it. An unknown network is not an error: it yields a zeroed entry with an empty name rather than an error.

params.name: networkClass
params.description: Network class: 1 for NoM, 2 for EVM chains.

params.name: chainId
params.description: The chain id within the class.

result.name: networkInfo
result.description: The network entry, or a zeroed entry when unknown.

methods.name: embedded.bridge.getAllNetworks
methods.summary: Returns one page of the registered bridged networks.
methods.description: Pages over every network registered with the bridge, in storage-key order (ascending network class, then ascending chain id). count is the total number of registered networks, not the number of entries in list. A pageSize above 1024 is rejected with api.ErrPageSizeParamTooBig.

params.name: pageIndex
params.description: 0-based page number.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Number of networks per page; must be at most 1024.

result.name: networkInfoList
result.description: One page of registered networks; count is the total number of networks.

methods.name: embedded.bridge.getFeeTokenPair
methods.summary: Returns the wrap fees the bridge has accumulated for a ZTS token.
methods.description: Returns the wrap fees the bridge has accumulated for the given ZTS token, in that token's smallest units, at the frontier momentum. A token with no recorded fees yields an accumulated fee of "0", not an error.

params.name: tokenStandard

result.name: feeTokenPair

methods.name: embedded.bridge.getWrapTokenRequestById
methods.summary: Returns the wrap request with the given id.
methods.description: Returns the wrap request whose id is the hash of the WrapToken send block that created it, augmented with its ZTS token info and the momentums left until the orchestrator considers it final. An unknown id produces an error rather than a null result.

params.name: id
params.description: The wrap request id (hash of its WrapToken send block).

result.name: wrapTokenRequest
result.description: The wrap request.

methods.name: embedded.bridge.getAllWrapTokenRequests
methods.summary: Returns one page of all wrap requests, newest first.
methods.description: Pages over every wrap request ever created, newest first (descending creation momentum height, ties by ascending request id). count is the total number of requests. A request whose ZTS token no longer exists is returned with a null token; one whose token lookup fails outright is silently dropped from the page.

params.name: pageIndex
params.description: 0-based page number.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Number of requests per page.

result.name: wrapTokenRequestList
result.description: One page of wrap requests, newest first; count is the total number of requests.

methods.name: embedded.bridge.getAllWrapTokenRequestsByToAddress
methods.summary: Returns one page of the wrap requests headed to a destination address.
methods.description: Pages over the wrap requests whose destination address equals toAddress, newest first. The comparison is an exact string match and requests store the destination lowercased, so a mixed-case toAddress matches nothing; an empty toAddress matches every request. count is the number of matching requests.

params.name: toAddress
params.description: Lowercased destination address on the target network; empty matches every request.

params.name: pageIndex
params.description: 0-based page number.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Number of requests per page.

result.name: wrapTokenRequestList
result.description: One page of matching wrap requests, newest first; count is the number of matching requests.

methods.name: embedded.bridge.getAllWrapTokenRequestsByToAddressNetworkClassAndChainId
methods.summary: Returns one page of the wrap requests headed to a network, optionally narrowed to a destination address.
methods.description: Pages over the wrap requests headed to the network identified by networkClass and chainId, newest first, optionally narrowed to a destination address: an empty toAddress matches every request of the network, otherwise the same exact, lowercase string match as getAllWrapTokenRequestsByToAddress applies. count is the number of matching requests.

params.name: toAddress
params.description: Lowercased destination address; empty matches every request of the network.

params.name: networkClass
params.description: Destination network class.

params.name: chainId
params.description: Destination chain id.

params.name: pageIndex
params.description: 0-based page number.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Number of requests per page.

result.name: wrapTokenRequestList
result.description: One page of matching wrap requests, newest first; count is the number of matching requests.

methods.name: embedded.bridge.getAllUnsignedWrapTokenRequests
methods.summary: Returns one page of the wrap requests the orchestrator has not signed yet, oldest first.
methods.description: Pages over the wrap requests the orchestrator has not signed yet (empty signature), oldest first (ascending creation momentum height). count is the total number of unsigned requests. When no requests are unsigned the result has count 0 and a null list.

params.name: pageIndex
params.description: 0-based page number.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Number of requests per page.

result.name: wrapTokenRequestList
result.description: One page of unsigned wrap requests, oldest first; count is the total number of unsigned requests.

methods.name: embedded.bridge.getUnwrapTokenRequestByHashAndLog
methods.summary: Returns the unwrap request for a source transaction hash and log index.
methods.description: Returns the unwrap request registered for the given deposit transaction hash and event log index on the source network, augmented with its ZTS token info and the momentums left until it can be redeemed. It produces an error for an unknown request, and also when the request's token pair has been removed from the network's configuration, since the redeem delay can no longer be computed.

params.name: transactionHash
params.description: Transaction hash of the deposit event on the source network.

params.name: logIndex
params.description: Event log index of the deposit on the source network.

result.name: unwrapTokenRequest
result.description: The unwrap request.

methods.name: embedded.bridge.getAllUnwrapTokenRequests
methods.summary: Returns one page of all unwrap requests, in storage-key order.
methods.description: Pages over every unwrap request, ordered by its storage key (ascending source transaction hash, then log index), which bears no relation to registration time. count is the total number of requests. The whole call fails if any request on the page references a token pair that has been removed from its network's configuration.

params.name: pageIndex
params.description: 0-based page number.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Number of requests per page.

result.name: unwrapTokenRequestList
result.description: One page of unwrap requests in storage-key order; count is the total number of requests.

methods.name: embedded.bridge.getAllUnwrapTokenRequestsByToAddress
methods.summary: Returns one page of the unwrap requests redeemable by a NoM address.
methods.description: Pages over the unwrap requests redeemable by the NoM address toAddress. With a non-empty toAddress the matching requests are sorted newest first (descending registration momentum height; the comparator has no tie-break, so requests registered at the same height appear in unspecified order). An empty toAddress matches every request but skips the sort, leaving the storage-key order of getAllUnwrapTokenRequests. count is the number of matching requests. Like getAllUnwrapTokenRequests, the whole call fails if any request on the page references a token pair that has been removed from its network's configuration.

params.name: toAddress
params.description: NoM beneficiary address; empty matches every request (in storage-key order).

params.name: pageIndex
params.description: 0-based page number.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Number of requests per page.

result.name: unwrapTokenRequestList
result.description: One page of matching unwrap requests; count is the number of matching requests.

methods.name: embedded.htlc.getById
methods.summary: Returns the active HTLC entry with the given id.
methods.description: Returns the hash time-locked contract entry whose id is the hash of the send block that created it, read from htlc contract state at the frontier momentum. The entry names the time-locked creator and the hash-locked counterparty, the locked token and amount, the expiration time, and the hash lock with its hash type and maximum preimage size. Entries are deleted from state as soon as they are unlocked or reclaimed, so an id that never existed or has already been spent yields the ErrDataNonExistent error ("data non existent", code -32000), not a null result.

params.name: id
params.description: The entry id: the hash of the send block that created the HTLC.

result.name: htlcInfo
result.description: The active HTLC entry; the call errors with ErrDataNonExistent when no active entry has that id.

examples.name: getByIdCallShape
examples.description: Request-only example documenting the call shape. No populated result is shown because no active HTLC existed on mainnet at capture time (entries are deleted on unlock or reclaim); see getByIdNonExistent for the node's actual response to a spent id.

examples.name: getByIdNonExistent
examples.description: Live response for a known id whose HTLC was already unlocked or reclaimed: the node returns the ErrDataNonExistent error rather than a null result.

methods.name: embedded.htlc.getProxyUnlockStatus
methods.summary: Reports whether an address permits proxy unlocking of HTLCs hash-locked to it.
methods.description: Reports whether address allows proxy unlocking, read from htlc contract state at the frontier momentum. When true, any address that knows the preimage may unlock an HTLC hash-locked to address (the funds still go to the hash-locked address); when false, only address itself may unlock. The flag is toggled per address through the contract's AllowProxyUnlock and DenyProxyUnlock methods; neither deletes the stored flag, and an address that has never called either defaults to true (the missing entry is treated as allowed), so the method never errors for an unset address.

params.name: address
params.description: Address whose proxy-unlock preference to query.

result.name: proxyUnlockStatus
result.description: True when proxy unlocking is permitted for HTLCs hash-locked to the address (the default), false when only the address itself may unlock.

examples.name: getProxyUnlockStatusDefault
examples.description: An address that has never toggled the flag returns the default true.

methods.name: embedded.liquidity.getLiquidityInfo
methods.summary: Returns the liquidity contract's global configuration state.
methods.description: Returns the liquidity contract's global state at the frontier momentum: the administrator address, whether staking is halted, the extra ZNN and QSR distributed each epoch from the contract's own balance on top of the protocol liquidity emission, and the whitelisted token tuples with their ZNN and QSR reward percentages (basis points) and minimum stake amounts. Before the state is first written it reads as defaults: the initial administrator from vm/constants, not halted, zero extra rewards and no token tuples.

result.name: liquidityInfo
result.description: The contract's administrator, halt flag, extra rewards and token tuples.

methods.name: embedded.liquidity.getLiquidityStakeEntriesByAddress
methods.summary: Returns one page of an address's active liquidity stake entries.
methods.description: Pages over the active (not yet revoked) liquidity stake entries of address, read from contract state at the frontier momentum and sorted by ascending expiration time (soonest-expiring first) with ties broken by ascending entry id. Each entry carries the staked and weighted amounts in the LP token's smallest units, unix-second timestamps, and the entry id used to cancel it. totalAmount, totalWeightedAmount and count sum every active entry of the address, not just the returned page. A pageSize above 1024 is rejected with ErrPageSizeParamTooBig.

params.name: address
params.description: The staker address whose active entries to list.

params.name: pageIndex
params.description: 0-based page number.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Number of entries per page; must be at most 1024.

result.name: liquidityStakeList
result.description: One page of the address's active stake entries; the totals and count cover all active entries, not just the page.

methods.name: embedded.liquidity.getUncollectedReward
methods.summary: Returns the liquidity rewards credited to an address but not yet collected.
methods.description: Returns the ZNN and QSR liquidity rewards credited to address but not yet collected, read from contract state at the frontier momentum. Liquidity rewards can include both ZNN and QSR. An address with nothing to collect yields a deposit with both amounts 0, not an error.

params.name: address
params.description: Address whose uncollected rewards to query.

result.name: rewardDeposit
result.description: Uncollected ZNN and QSR amounts; both 0 when nothing is collectable.

methods.name: embedded.liquidity.getFrontierRewardByPage
methods.summary: Pages over the per-epoch liquidity reward history of an address, newest epoch first.
methods.description: Pages over the per-epoch liquidity reward history of address, newest epoch first; epochs without a recorded reward yield zero-amount entries. Page 0 starts at the last epoch the contract has processed and each entry steps one epoch back; the page is cut short at epoch 0 (when no epoch has been processed yet the list is empty). A pageSize above 1024 is rejected with ErrPageSizeParamTooBig. In the result, count is the total number of epochs the contract has processed so far (last processed epoch + 1), not the number of entries in list.

params.name: address
params.description: Address whose reward history to page over.

params.name: pageIndex
params.description: 0-based page number, counting backwards from the last processed epoch.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Number of epochs per page; must be at most 1024.

result.name: rewardHistoryList
result.description: Reward entries in descending epoch order; count is the total number of processed epochs.

methods.name: embedded.liquidity.getSecurityInfo
methods.summary: Returns the time-challenge security configuration of the liquidity contract.
methods.description: Returns the security configuration of the liquidity contract at the frontier momentum: the guardian addresses that can vote in a new administrator during an emergency, each guardian's current vote, and the two time-challenge delays in momentums (administratorDelay for administrator and guardian changes, softDelay for the other protected methods). Before security is initialized it reads as the minimum delays from vm/constants with no guardians.

result.name: securityInfo
result.description: The guardians, their votes and the two time-challenge delays.

methods.name: embedded.liquidity.getTimeChallengesInfo
methods.summary: Returns the recorded time challenges of the liquidity contract's protected methods.
methods.description: Returns the recorded time challenges for the liquidity contract's protected administrator methods, in this fixed method order: NominateGuardians, SetTokenTuple, ChangeAdministrator and SetAdditionalReward. Methods that have never been challenged are omitted from the list, and count is the number of entries returned. A satisfied challenge keeps its slot with an all-zero parameters hash.

result.name: timeChallengesList
result.description: The recorded challenge entries; count is the number of entries, methods never challenged are omitted.

methods.name: embedded.pillar.getQsrRegistrationCost
methods.summary: Returns the QSR deposit currently required to register a new pillar.
methods.description: Returns the QSR deposit currently required to register a new pillar. It is computed on the fly, not read from a stored value: the base amount (150,000 QSR) plus the per-pillar increase (10,000 QSR) for each active non-legacy pillar registered at the frontier momentum. The amount is a base-10 string in smallest units.

result.name: qsrRegistrationCost
result.description: Required QSR deposit in smallest units, as a base-10 string.

methods.name: embedded.pillar.getAll
methods.summary: Returns one page of the active pillars, sorted by descending weight.
methods.description: Returns one page of the active (non-revoked) pillars, of both legacy and regular type, read from contract state at the frontier momentum and enriched with weights and momentum statistics from the consensus cache. The full list is sorted by descending weight (ties by ascending name) and ranked before the page window is cut, so rank is global, and count is the total number of active pillars. A pageSize above 1024 is rejected with ErrPageSizeParamTooBig.

params.name: pageIndex
params.description: 0-based page number.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Number of pillars per page; must be at most 1024.

result.name: pillarInfoList
result.description: One page of active pillars sorted by descending weight (ties by ascending name); count is the total number of active pillars.

methods.name: embedded.pillar.getByName
methods.summary: Returns the active pillar registered under the given name.
methods.description: Returns the active pillar registered under the given name, with the same enrichment as embedded.pillar.getAll, or null without an error when no such pillar exists. Like embedded.pillar.getByOwner it considers at most the 1024 highest-weighted pillars.

params.name: name
params.description: The pillar name to look up.

result.name: pillarInfo
result.description: The pillar, or null when no active pillar with that name exists.

methods.name: embedded.pillar.getByOwner
methods.summary: Returns the active pillars whose owner (stake) address matches.
methods.description: Returns the active pillars whose owner (stake) address is stakeAddress, with the same enrichment and ordering as embedded.pillar.getAll. It scans only the first getAll page of maximum size, so at most the 1024 highest-weighted pillars are considered. An empty list is returned when none match.

params.name: stakeAddress
params.description: Owner (stake) address to filter by.

result.name: pillarInfoArray
result.description: Matching pillars; empty when none match.

methods.name: embedded.pillar.getDelegatedPillar
methods.summary: Returns the delegation of an address.
methods.description: Returns the delegation of addr read from contract state at the frontier momentum, or null without an error when addr does not delegate. The status is 1 (active) only when the delegated pillar still exists with revoke time 0; a revoked or missing pillar record yields 2 (inactive) while the delegation entry itself remains. The weight is computed on the fly from addr's ZNN balance, not from contract state.

params.name: address
params.description: Address whose delegation to query.

result.name: delegation
result.description: The delegation, or null when the address does not delegate.

methods.summary: Returns the QSR an address has deposited toward a pillar registration.
methods.description: Returns the QSR address has deposited in the pillar contract toward a future pillar registration, read from contract state at the frontier momentum. The amount is a base-10 string in smallest units; an address with no deposit yields "0".

params.name: address

result.name: depositedQsr
result.description: Deposited QSR in smallest units, as a base-10 string; "0" when no deposit exists.

methods.summary: Returns the pillar rewards credited to an address but not yet collected.
methods.description: Returns the ZNN and QSR pillar rewards credited to address but not yet collected, read from contract state at the frontier momentum. An address with nothing to collect yields a deposit with both amounts 0, not an error.

params.name: address
params.description: Address whose uncollected rewards to query.

result.name: rewardDeposit

methods.name: embedded.pillar.checkNameAvailability
methods.summary: Reports whether a name can still be used to register a pillar.
methods.description: Reports whether name can still be used to register a pillar. Unlike embedded.pillar.getAll, the check runs against every pillar record in contract state, including revoked ones, so a revoked pillar's name stays unavailable.

result.name: available

methods.name: embedded.plasma.get
methods.summary: Returns an address's plasma at the frontier momentum.
methods.description: Returns the plasma of address at the frontier momentum: the total QSR fused with it as beneficiary, the plasma that amount converts to, and the plasma currently available once the plasma held by the address's unconfirmed account blocks is subtracted.

params.name: address
params.description: Address whose plasma to query.

result.name: plasmaInfo
result.description: The address's plasma totals at the frontier momentum.

methods.name: embedded.plasma.getEntriesByAddress
methods.summary: Returns one page of the fusion entries owned by an address.
methods.description: Returns one page of the fusion entries owned by address (the address that sent the fuse transactions, not the beneficiary), read from plasma contract state at the frontier momentum and sorted by ascending expiration height with ties broken by beneficiary. qsrAmount and count in the result cover all of the owner's entries. A pageSize above 1024 is rejected with ErrPageSizeParamTooBig.

params.name: address
params.description: Owner address whose fusion entries to list.

params.name: pageIndex
params.description: 0-based page number.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Number of entries per page; must be at most 1024.

result.name: fusionEntryList

methods.name: embedded.plasma.getRequiredPoWForAccountBlock
methods.summary: Computes the proof-of-work difficulty a prospective account block needs beyond its available fused plasma.
methods.description: Computes, against the frontier momentum, how much proof of work the described account block would need on top of the address's available fused plasma. The base plasma is the block's minimum requirement (a flat base for receive blocks; a base plus a per-byte data charge for sends to user addresses; the called method's fixed cost for sends to embedded contracts). When available plasma covers it the required difficulty is 0; otherwise the difficulty is proportional to the missing plasma (1500 per unit), and a shortfall beyond what proof of work may cover for one block is rejected with an error. A user-send block without a destination address is rejected.

methods.name: subscribe.toMomentums
methods.summary: Streams the hash and height of every momentum inserted into the chain.
methods.description:
Opens a websocket subscription that streams the identity (hash and height) of every momentum inserted into the chain after the subscription is installed.

Wire contract: invoked as ledger.subscribe with the first positional parameter "momentums" and no further arguments. The call returns a subscription id string; thereafter the server pushes a ledger.subscription notification for each inserted momentum, whose result is a one-element array of SubscribeMomentumNotification objects (hash, height). This is a connection-oriented (websocket/ipc) call; over plain HTTP it fails with ErrNotificationsUnsupported. There is no backfill of momentums committed before the subscription.

result.name: subscriptionId
result.description: The subscription id returned by the ledger.subscribe call. Subsequent momentum events arrive as ledger.subscription notifications, each carrying a one-element array of SubscribeMomentumNotification objects; see the schema for that pushed payload shape.

methods.name: subscribe.toAllAccountBlocks

methods.description:
Opens a websocket subscription that streams every account block committed to the chain after the subscription is installed.

Wire contract: invoked as ledger.subscribe with the first positional parameter "allAccountBlocks" and no further arguments. The call returns a subscription id string; thereafter, for each momentum that commits at least one account block, the server pushes a ledger.subscription notification whose result is an array of SubscribeAccountBlockNotification objects covering that momentum (descendant blocks from embedded contracts included, flattened after their parent). This is a connection-oriented (websocket/ipc) call; over plain HTTP it fails with ErrNotificationsUnsupported. There is no backfill of blocks committed before the subscription.

params.name: subscriptionName
params.description: The subscription name; the literal string "allAccountBlocks" as the first positional parameter of ledger.subscribe.

result.name: subscriptionId

Opens a websocket subscription that streams the committed account blocks whose address field equals the given address, i.e. the blocks of a single account chain, as they are committed after the subscription is installed.

Wire contract: invoked as ledger.subscribe with the first positional parameter "accountBlocksByAddress" followed by the address. The call returns a subscription id string; thereafter, for each momentum that commits at least one matching block, the server pushes a ledger.subscription notification whose result is an array of SubscribeAccountBlockNotification objects (matching blocks of that momentum); momentums with no matching block produce no notification. This is a connection-oriented (websocket/ipc) call; over plain HTTP it fails with ErrNotificationsUnsupported. There is no backfill of blocks committed before the subscription.

params.name: subscriptionName

params.name: address

result.name: subscriptionId
result.description: The subscription id returned by the ledger.subscribe call. Subsequent matching account-block events arrive as ledger.subscription notifications, each carrying an array of SubscribeAccountBlockNotification objects for one momentum; see the schema for that pushed payload shape.

methods.description:
Opens a websocket subscription that streams send blocks destined for the given address (transfers the address has yet to receive) as they are committed after the subscription is installed.

Wire contract: invoked as ledger.subscribe with the first positional parameter "unreceivedAccountBlocksByAddress" followed by the address. The call returns a subscription id string; thereafter, for each momentum that commits at least one matching send block, the server pushes a ledger.subscription notification whose result is an array of SubscribeAccountBlockNotification objects (the matching sends of that momentum, where toAddress equals the subscribed address). Only sends committed after the subscription is installed are streamed; transfers already pending must be fetched with ledger.getUnreceivedBlocksByAddress. This is a connection-oriented (websocket/ipc) call; over plain HTTP it fails with ErrNotificationsUnsupported.

result.description: The subscription id returned by the ledger.subscribe call. Subsequent matching send-block events arrive as ledger.subscription notifications, each carrying an array of SubscribeAccountBlockNotification objects for one momentum; see the schema for that pushed payload shape.

status.description: Project status: 0 voting, 1 active, 3 closed, 4 completed.

phaseIds.description: The project's phase ids, in submission order.

votes.description: The tally of pillar votes cast on the project itself.

phases.description: The project's phases in phaseIds order, each with its own vote breakdown.

AcceleratorProjectList.description: One page of projects as returned by embedded.accelerator.getAll. count is the total number of projects in contract state, not the number of entries in list.

count.description: Total number of projects in contract state.

BridgeInfo.description: The bridge contract's global state, as reported by embedded.bridge.getBridgeInfo. Before the state is first written it reads as defaults: the administrator hard-coded in vm/constants, empty TSS keys, key generation disallowed, not halted, the minimum unhalt duration and metadata "{}".

administrator.description: Address allowed to call the administrator-gated methods. Emergency zeroes it, after which the guardians vote in a replacement.

compressedTssECDSAPubKey.description: Base64 compressed form of the ECDSA public key produced by the orchestrator's key-generation ceremony; empty before any ceremony has completed.

decompressedTssECDSAPubKey.description: Base64 decompressed form of the same key; orchestrator signatures are verified against it.

allowKeyGen.description: Whether the orchestrator is currently authorized to run a new key-generation ceremony.

halted.description: Whether the bridge is halted; while true, all token movements are rejected.

unhaltedAt.description: Momentum height of the administrator's last Unhalt call; the bridge stays inactive until unhaltDurationInMomentums momentums have passed since it.

unhaltDurationInMomentums.description: Length, in momentums, of the post-Unhalt waiting window; at least constants.MinUnhaltDurationInMomentums.

tssNonce.description: Incremental nonce sequencing the administrative TSS-signed messages, preventing replays.

BridgeSecurityInfo.description: The time-challenge security configuration of the bridge contract, as reported by embedded.bridge.getSecurityInfo. Before security is initialized it reads as the minimum delays from vm/constants with no guardians.

guardians.description: Guardian addresses that may vote in a new administrator while the contract is in emergency.

guardiansVotes.description: Per-guardian, the administrator address that guardian currently votes for, positionally aligned with guardians; the zero address means no vote.

administratorDelay.description: Time-challenge delay, in momentums, for administrator and guardian changes.

softDelay.description: Time-challenge delay, in momentums, for the other challenged methods.

BridgeOrchestratorInfo.description: The parameters the orchestrator network operates under, as reported by embedded.bridge.getOrchestratorInfo. The node only stores and serves these values (on-chain validation requires merely that the four configurable fields are nonzero), so the descriptions state the off-chain orchestrator's intended use, not behavior this contract enforces. Before the state is first written every field reads as 0.

windowSize.description: Length, in momentums, of the window within which the orchestrator performs at most one signing ceremony (wrap or unwrap).

keyGenThreshold.description: Minimum number of participants required for a key-generation ceremony.

confirmationsToFinality.description: Momentums a wrap request must age before the orchestrator treats it as final and signs it.

allowKeyGenHeight.description: Momentum height of the last SetAllowKeyGen call that allowed key generation; the orchestrator inspects the producing pillars of the day before it.

BridgeTimeChallengeInfo.description: One recorded time challenge for a protected administrator method. A time challenge delays the method: the first call only records the hash of its parameters and the momentum height it was made at, and the change takes effect when the same call is repeated with identical parameters after the security delay has passed. The JSON keys are the Go field names (no struct tags), so they are capitalized.

MethodName.description: The protected method this challenge slot belongs to (one of NominateGuardians, ChangeTssECDSAPubKey, ChangeAdministrator, SetTokenPair).

ParamsHash.description: Hash of the pending parameters; all-zero once the challenge has completed.

ChallengeStartHeight.description: Momentum height of the first (recording) submission.

BridgeTimeChallengesInfo.description: The recorded time challenges for the bridge's protected administrator methods (NominateGuardians, ChangeTssECDSAPubKey, ChangeAdministrator, SetTokenPair), as returned by embedded.bridge.getTimeChallengesInfo. Methods that have never been challenged are omitted from the list, so count is the number of methods with a recorded challenge, not a fixed four.

count.description: Number of methods with a recorded time challenge.

BridgeTokenPair.description: Links a ZTS token to its counterpart on a paired network. Part of a BridgeNetworkInfo.

tokenStandard.description: The NoM-side ZTS token of the pair.

tokenAddress.description: The token's contract address on the paired network.

bridgeable.description: Whether outgoing wraps of this token are currently allowed.

redeemable.description: Whether incoming redemptions of this token are currently allowed.

owned.description: When true the bridge owns the ZTS token, so wraps burn the net amount and redeems mint it; when false wraps hold the tokens in the contract and redeems pay out of its balance.

minAmount.description: Smallest wrap accepted for this token, in its smallest units, as a base-10 string.

feePercentage.description: Wrap fee in basis points of constants.MaximumFee (10000 = 100%).

redeemDelay.description: Momentums between an unwrap request's registration and its earliest redemption.

metadata.description: Free-form JSON metadata string for the pair.

BridgeNetworkInfo.description: One bridged network, as reported by embedded.bridge.getNetworkInfo and embedded.bridge.getAllNetworks. An unknown network is not an error: it reads as a zeroed entry with an empty name, chain id and contract address, metadata "{}" and no token pairs.

networkClass.description: Network class: 1 for NoM, 2 for EVM-compatible chains.

chainId.description: The specific chain id within the class.

name.description: Human-readable network name; empty for an unknown network.

contractAddress.description: Address of the bridge contract deployed on that network.

tokenPairs.description: The token pairs that can cross this network.

BridgeNetworkInfoList.description: One page of bridged networks, as returned by embedded.bridge.getAllNetworks. count is the total number of registered networks, not the number of entries in list.

BridgeWrapTokenRequest.description: A wrap request (a transfer leaving NoM) augmented with RPC-only context. id is the hash of the WrapToken send block that created it, toAddress the destination address on the target network (stored lowercased), amount the full sent amount and fee the part the bridge keeps (feePercentage basis points of the amount), both in the token's smallest units as base-10 strings. signature is the orchestrator's base64 TSS signature, empty until the request has been signed.

id.description: Request id: the hash of the WrapToken send block.

toAddress.description: Destination address on the target network, stored lowercased.

tokenAddress.description: The token's address on the destination network, resolved from the network's token pairs at query time.

amount.description: Full sent amount in smallest units, as a base-10 string.

fee.description: Part of the amount kept by the bridge, in smallest units, as a base-10 string.

signature.description: Base64 TSS signature attached by UpdateWrapRequest; empty until signed.

creationMomentumHeight.description: Momentum height at which the request was created.

token.description: ZTS token registry entry for tokenStandard; null when the token no longer exists.

confirmationsToFinality.description: Momentums still to elapse before the orchestrator considers the request final and signs it; 0 once it has aged the orchestrator's confirmationsToFinality momentums from creationMomentumHeight.

BridgeWrapTokenRequestList.description: One page of wrap requests. count is the total number of requests that matched the query, not the number of entries in list.

BridgeUnwrapTokenRequest.description: An unwrap request (a transfer entering NoM) augmented with RPC-only context. It is registered by an orchestrator-signed UnwrapToken call and identified by the transaction hash and event log index of the deposit on the source network. toAddress is the NoM address that may redeem it and amount is in the token's smallest units as a base-10 string.

registrationMomentumHeight.description: Momentum height at which the request was registered on NoM.

transactionHash.description: Transaction hash of the deposit event on the source network.

logIndex.description: Event log index of the deposit on the source network.

toAddress.description: The NoM address that may redeem the request.

tokenAddress.description: The token's address on the source network.

amount.description: Amount in smallest units, as a base-10 string.

signature.description: Base64 TSS signature authorizing the registration.

redeemed.description: 1 once the request has been redeemed, 0 otherwise.

revoked.description: 1 once the administrator has revoked the request (it can then never be redeemed), 0 otherwise.

token.description: ZTS token registry entry for tokenStandard; null when the token no longer exists.

redeemableIn.description: Momentums still to elapse before Redeem is accepted; 0 once the request has aged the token pair's redeem delay from registrationMomentumHeight.

BridgeUnwrapTokenRequestList.description: One page of unwrap requests. count is the total number of requests that matched the query, not the number of entries in list.

BridgeZtsFeesInfo.description: The wrap fees the bridge has accumulated in one ZTS token, as returned by embedded.bridge.getFeeTokenPair. A token with no recorded fees yields an accumulated fee of 0, not an error.

tokenStandard.description: The token the fees were collected in.

accumulatedFee.description: Accumulated wrap fee in the token's smallest units, as a base-10 string; "0" when none.

BridgeToken.description: The ZTS token registry entry embedded in wrap and unwrap requests. Supply fields are big.Int values rendered as base-10 strings.

totalSupply.description: Circulating supply in raw base units, as a base-10 string.

decimals.description: Number of decimal places used to display raw base-unit amounts.

owner.description: Address allowed to mint and to change ownership.

maxSupply.description: Maximum mintable supply in raw base units, as a base-10 string.

HtlcInfo.description: One stored hash time-locked contract entry, as returned by embedded.htlc.getById. The funds are held by the htlc embedded contract: the time-locked creator may reclaim them once the expiration time has been reached, and the hash-locked counterparty may unlock them before then by revealing a preimage whose digest matches the hash lock.

id.description: Entry id: the hash of the send block that created the HTLC (the Create call). It is recovered from the storage key, not stored in the entry value.

timeLocked.description: The creator's address, which funded the entry and may reclaim the funds once the expiration time has been reached.

hashLocked.description: The counterparty's address, entitled to unlock the funds before expiration by revealing a valid preimage; the unlocked funds always go to this address.

tokenStandard.description: ZTS identifier of the locked token.

amount.description: Locked amount in the token's smallest units, as a base-10 string.

expirationTime.description: Expiration time in Unix seconds. Strictly before it the hash-locked counterparty may unlock; once it is reached the time-locked creator may reclaim.

hashType.description: Algorithm of the hash lock digest: 0 for SHA3-256, 1 for SHA-256. Both produce a 32-byte digest.

keyMaxSize.description: Maximum accepted preimage length in bytes.

hashLock.description: The 32-byte hash lock digest the preimage must hash to (under hashType), base64 encoded.

LiquidityTokenTuple.description: The reward configuration of one whitelisted liquidity (LP) token. The two percentage fields are in basis points (10000 = 100%); across all tuples the znnPercentage values sum to 10000 and the qsrPercentage values sum to 10000.

znnPercentage.description: The token's share of the epoch's liquidity ZNN rewards, in basis points (10000 = 100%).

qsrPercentage.description: The token's share of the epoch's liquidity QSR rewards, in basis points (10000 = 100%).

minAmount.description: Smallest stake accepted for this token, in the token's smallest units, as a base-10 string.

LiquidityInfo.description: The liquidity contract's global state as reported by embedded.liquidity.getLiquidityInfo. Before the state is first written it reads as defaults: the initial administrator hard-coded in vm/constants, not halted, zero extra rewards and no token tuples.

isHalted.description: Whether staking on the contract is currently halted.

znnReward.description: Extra ZNN distributed each epoch from the contract's own balance on top of the protocol liquidity emission, in smallest units, as a base-10 string.

qsrReward.description: Extra QSR distributed each epoch from the contract's own balance on top of the protocol liquidity emission, in smallest units, as a base-10 string.

tokenTuples.description: The whitelisted reward-earning LP token tuples.

LiquidityStakeEntry.description: One active liquidity stake entry: an amount of an LP token locked from startTime until expirationTime, earning rewards proportional to its weightedAmount (the duration-weighted stake).

amount.description: Staked amount in the token's smallest units, as a base-10 string.

tokenStandard.description: The staked LP token's ZTS standard.

weightedAmount.description: Duration-weighted amount reward shares are computed from, in smallest units, as a base-10 string.

startTime.description: Unix seconds at which the stake was created.

revokeTime.description: Unix seconds at which the stake was cancelled; 0 while the stake is active. Active entries (revokeTime 0) are the only ones listed.

expirationTime.description: Unix seconds from which the stake may be cancelled to recover the locked tokens.

stakeAddress.description: The staker's address, recovered from the storage key.

id.description: Entry id: the hash of the LiquidityStake send block; used to cancel the stake.

LiquidityStakeList.description: One page of an address's active liquidity stake entries, returned by embedded.liquidity.getLiquidityStakeEntriesByAddress. totalAmount, totalWeightedAmount and count cover all of the address's active entries, not just the page.

totalAmount.description: Sum of the staked amount of every active entry of the address, in smallest units, as a base-10 string.

totalWeightedAmount.description: Sum of the weighted amount of every active entry of the address, in smallest units, as a base-10 string.

count.description: Total number of active stake entries owned by the address.

list.description: The page of entries, sorted by ascending expiration time (soonest-expiring first) with ties broken by ascending entry id.

LiquiditySecurityInfo.description: The time-challenge security configuration of the liquidity contract, as reported by embedded.liquidity.getSecurityInfo. Before security is initialized it reads as the minimum delays from vm/constants with no guardians.

guardians.description: The guardian addresses that may vote in a new administrator while the contract is in emergency.

guardiansVotes.description: Per guardian (positionally aligned with guardians), the administrator address it currently votes for; the zero address means no vote.

administratorDelay.description: Time-challenge delay in momentums for administrator-level actions (changing the administrator or the guardians).

softDelay.description: Time-challenge delay in momentums for the other challenged actions (SetTokenTuple, SetAdditionalReward).

LiquidityTimeChallengeInfo.description: The state of one method's time challenge. A sensitive administrator action must be submitted twice with identical parameters, separated by the security delay (administrator or soft); the first call records the parameters hash and the momentum height it was made at, and the change takes effect on the matching second call. The field names are capitalized because the underlying Go struct carries no json tags.

MethodName.description: The protected method the challenge slot belongs to.

ParamsHash.description: Hash of the pending parameters; all-zero once the challenge has been satisfied.

ChallengeStartHeight.description: Momentum height of the first (recording) submission.

LiquidityTimeChallengesList.description: The recorded time challenges of the liquidity contract's protected administrator methods, as returned by embedded.liquidity.getTimeChallengesInfo. count is the number of entries in list; methods that have never been challenged are omitted.

count.description: Number of challenge entries in list.

PillarStats.description: Counts the momentums a pillar has produced in the current epoch against the number it was expected to produce, as reported by the consensus cache.

producedMomentums.description: Momentums produced by the pillar in the current epoch.

expectedMomentums.description: Momentums the pillar was expected to produce in the current epoch.

PillarInfo.description: Describes one registered pillar as reported by embedded.pillar.getAll and its derived methods. The name, the three addresses, the reward-sharing percentages and revokeTimestamp come from contract state at the frontier momentum. isRevocable and revokeCooldown are computed from the registration time and the frontier momentum timestamp: a pillar's lifetime cycles through an 83-day locked window followed by a 7-day revocable window. rank, weight and currentStats come from the consensus cache; while the cache is cold they remain at their zero placeholders.

rank.description: 0-based position after sorting all active pillars by descending weight (ties broken by ascending name); assigned globally before any page window is cut.

type.description: Pillar type: 1 for legacy pillars, 2 for regular ones.

producerAddress.description: The address used to produce momentums.

withdrawAddress.description: The address that collects the pillar's rewards.

isRevocable.description: Whether the pillar is currently in the 7-day revocable window.

revokeCooldown.description: Seconds until the revocability state flips: until revocation opens while locked, until it closes while revocable.

revokeTimestamp.description: Unix seconds of revocation; 0 while the pillar is not revoked.

giveMomentumRewardPercentage.description: Percentage of momentum rewards shared with delegators.

giveDelegateRewardPercentage.description: Percentage of delegation rewards shared with delegators.

currentStats.description: Momentum-production statistics for the current epoch, from the consensus cache.

weight.description: The pillar's voting weight in producer elections, from the consensus cache, as a base-10 string.

PillarInfoList.description: One page of pillars as returned by embedded.pillar.getAll. count is the total number of active pillars, not the number of entries in list.

GetDelegatedPillarResponse.description: Describes an address's current delegation: the delegated pillar's name, its status, and the delegating address's own ZNN balance at the frontier momentum, which is what the delegation weighs.

status.description: 1 (active) while the delegated pillar exists in contract state with revoke time 0; 2 (inactive) when the pillar has been revoked or its registration no longer exists.

weight.description: The delegating address's own ZNN balance at the frontier momentum in smallest units, as a base-10 string.

RewardDeposit.description: ZNN and QSR rewards credited to an address by an embedded contract but not yet collected.

address.description: The address the rewards are credited to.

znnAmount.description: Uncollected ZNN in smallest units, as a base-10 string.

qsrAmount.description: Uncollected QSR in smallest units, as a base-10 string.

RewardHistoryEntry.description: The reward an address earned from one embedded contract during one epoch: the epoch number and the ZNN and QSR amounts credited for it, in smallest units.

epoch.description: Epoch number (24-hour window counted from the genesis timestamp, starting at 0).

znnAmount.description: ZNN credited for the epoch, in smallest units.

qsrAmount.description: QSR credited for the epoch, in smallest units.

RewardHistoryList.description: One page of per-epoch reward history. count is the total number of epochs the contract has processed so far (last processed epoch + 1), not the number of entries in list; list holds the requested page in descending epoch order.

count.description: Total number of epochs the contract has processed so far (last processed epoch + 1).

list.description: The requested page, in descending epoch order.

PillarEpochHistory.description: One pillar's recorded history for one epoch.

epoch.description: Epoch number the entry refers to.

giveBlockRewardPercentage.description: Percentage of momentum (block) rewards shared with delegators in that epoch.

giveDelegateRewardPercentage.description: Percentage of delegation rewards shared with delegators in that epoch.

producedBlockNum.description: Momentums the pillar produced in that epoch.

expectedBlockNum.description: Momentums the pillar was expected to produce in that epoch.

weight.description: The pillar's voting weight in that epoch, as a base-10 string.

PillarEpochHistoryList.description: One page of per-epoch pillar history. count depends on the producing method: embedded.pillar.getPillarEpochHistory sets it to the total number of processed epochs (last processed epoch + 1), while embedded.pillar.getPillarsHistoryByEpoch sets it to the number of pillar entries recorded for the requested epoch.

PlasmaInfo.description: Summarizes an address's plasma at the frontier momentum, as reported by embedded.plasma.get.

currentPlasma.description: Plasma currently available to the address: maxPlasma minus the plasma already held by the address's unconfirmed account blocks.

maxPlasma.description: Plasma that the total fused QSR (qsrAmount) converts to.

qsrAmount.description: Total QSR fused with this address as beneficiary, in the smallest unit (10^8 per QSR).

FusionEntry.description: One QSR fusion recorded in the plasma contract.

qsrAmount.description: Fused QSR amount, in the smallest unit (10^8 per QSR).

beneficiary.description: Address whose plasma this fusion backs.

expirationHeight.description: Momentum height starting at which the owner may cancel the fusion and reclaim the QSR.

id.description: Entry id: the hash of the send block that created the fusion.

FusionEntryList.description: One page of an owner's fusion entries, returned by embedded.plasma.getEntriesByAddress. qsrAmount and count cover all of the owner's entries, not just the page.

qsrAmount.description: Total QSR the owner has fused across all entries, in the smallest unit (10^8 per QSR).

count.description: Total number of fusion entries owned by the address.

list.description: The page of entries, sorted by ascending expiration height with ties broken by ascending beneficiary address.

GetRequiredParam.description: Describes the prospective account block passed to embedded.plasma.getRequiredPoWForAccountBlock. Sent as a single positional object parameter.

address.description: The sending (self) address of the block.

blockType.description: Account block type: 2 (user send) or 3 (user receive); see the nom block-type constants. toAddress is required for a user-send block.

toAddress.description: Destination address. Required for a user-send block (blockType 2); may be null for a receive block.

data.description: Optional data payload; its length raises the plasma requirement of send blocks. May be null.

availablePlasma.description: Plasma currently available to the address from fused QSR.

basePlasma.description: Minimum plasma the described block requires.

requiredDifficulty.description: Proof-of-work difficulty that would cover the shortfall (basePlasma minus availablePlasma); 0 when available plasma already suffices. The difficulty is proportional to the missing plasma (1500 per unit).

SentinelInfo.description: Describes one registered sentinel as reported by embedded.sentinel.getByOwner and embedded.sentinel.getAllActive. owner and registrationTimestamp come from contract state at the frontier momentum; active reports whether the sentinel's stored revoke timestamp is still 0. isRevocable and revokeCooldown are computed from the registration timestamp and the frontier momentum timestamp: a sentinel's lifetime cycles through a 27-day locked window followed by a 3-day revocable window.

owner.description: The address that registered the sentinel; each address can run at most one sentinel.

registrationTimestamp.description: Unix seconds at which the sentinel was registered.

isRevocable.description: Whether the sentinel is currently in the 3-day revocable window.

revokeCooldown.description: Seconds until the revocability state flips: until revocation opens while locked, until it closes while revocable.

active.description: Whether the sentinel is active (its stored revoke timestamp is still 0); false once it has been revoked.

SentinelInfoList.description: One page of sentinels as returned by embedded.sentinel.getAllActive. count is the total number of active sentinels, not the number of entries in list.

SporkInfo.description: One stored protocol-upgrade switch, as reported by embedded.spork.getAll. activated and enforcementHeight stay false and 0 until the spork is activated.

id.description: The spork id: the hash of the send block that created the spork.

activated.description: Whether the spork has been activated. Once activated, the gated feature applies from enforcementHeight onward.

enforcementHeight.description: Momentum height from which the activated feature applies: the frontier height at activation plus a fixed delay. 0 while the spork is not activated.

SporkInfoList.description: One page of sporks as returned by embedded.spork.getAll. count is the total number of sporks ever created, not the number of entries in list.

count.description: Total number of sporks ever created.

list.description: The requested page, in storage (spork id byte) order.

StakeEntry.description: One active stake as reported by embedded.stake.getEntriesByAddress. The stake can be cancelled once expirationTimestamp has passed, which returns the locked ZNN and removes the entry.

amount.description: The locked ZNN, in the smallest unit (10^8 per ZNN), as a base-10 string.

weightedAmount.description: The duration-weighted amount the QSR rewards are computed from, in smallest units, as a base-10 string: amount times (9 + duration in 30-day units) / 10, so a 30-day stake weighs 1x and each additional 30-day unit adds 0.1x, up to 2.1x at 360 days.

startTimestamp.description: Unix seconds at which the stake was created.

expirationTimestamp.description: Unix seconds at which the stake expires; the entry can be cancelled only once this has passed.

id.description: Entry id: the hash of the send block that created the stake, and the handle passed to the contract's Cancel method.

StakeList.description: One page of an address's active stake entries, returned by embedded.stake.getEntriesByAddress. count, totalAmount and totalWeightedAmount cover all of the address's active entries, not just the page.

totalAmount.description: Total locked ZNN summed over all of the address's active entries, in smallest units, as a base-10 string.

totalWeightedAmount.description: Total duration-weighted amount summed over all of the address's active entries, in smallest units, as a base-10 string.

count.description: Total number of the address's active stake entries.

list.description: The page of active entries, sorted by ascending expiration time (soonest expiring first) with ties broken by ascending entry id.

SwapAssetEntry.description: The swap balance still claimable by one legacy key, as returned by embedded.swap.getAssetsByKeyIdHash, with the decay for the current epoch already applied.

keyIdHash.description: Hex form of the SHA-256 hash of the legacy key id that owns the balance; echoes the requested hash.

znn.description: Claimable ZNN after decay, in smallest units, as a base-10 string.

qsr.description: Claimable QSR after decay, in smallest units, as a base-10 string.

SwapAssetEntrySimple.description: The swap balance of one legacy key without its key id hash, used as the value type of the embedded.swap.getAssets map (where the hash is already the key). Amounts have the decay for the current epoch applied.

znn.description: Claimable ZNN after decay, in smallest units, as a base-10 string.

qsr.description: Claimable QSR after decay, in smallest units, as a base-10 string.

SwapAssetMap.description: The full set of remaining swap balances returned by embedded.swap.getAssets, as a JSON object keyed by key id hash (a hex string) rather than a paged list. Every stored entry is present, including already-claimed or fully-decayed ones, which read back with zero amounts.

SwapLegacyPillarEntry.description: One legacy key's unredeemed legacy pillar slots, as returned by embedded.swap.getLegacyPillars. Read from the pillar contract's state, not the swap contract's.

keyIdHash.description: Hex form of the SHA-256 hash of the legacy key id that owns the slots.

numPillars.description: Number of legacy pillars the key may still redeem.

TokenInfoList.description: One page of tokens as returned by embedded.token.getAll and embedded.token.getByOwner. count is the total number of tokens that matched the producing method's filter, not the number of entries in list.

count.description: Total number of tokens matching the producing method's filter (all registered tokens for getAll; tokens owned by the address for getByOwner).

list.description: The requested page of token descriptions, in storage (ZTS identifier) order.

StatsOsInfo.description: Host operating system, memory and CPU details together with the node's current goroutine count, as returned by stats.osInfo. Failures while querying the OS are not surfaced: the affected fields are left at their zero values and no error is returned.

os.description: Host operating system as reported by the OS itself, for example "linux".

memoryTotal.description: The host's total physical memory in bytes.

memoryFree.description: Memory in bytes available for allocation without swapping (the OS "available" figure, which includes reclaimable caches, not strictly free memory).

numCPU.description: Number of logical CPUs usable by the node process.

numGoroutine.description: Number of goroutines currently running in the node process.

StatsProcessInfo.description: Identifies the node build serving the RPC, as returned by stats.processInfo. Both fields are fixed at build time.

version.description: Release version compiled into the binary, for example "v0.0.8"; shared-library (libznn) builds carry a "-libznn" suffix.

commit.description: Git revision the binary was built from, or an empty string when the build carries no VCS information.

StatsPeer.description: One node on the p2p network as seen by stats.networkInfo, used both for connected peers and for the local node's self entry.

publicKey.description: The peer's discovery node id: its 512-bit public key, hex-encoded without a 0x prefix.

ip.description: The peer's remote IP address as observed on the live connection. For the self entry it is the fixed placeholder "127.0.0.1".

name.description: The node name the peer advertised during the protocol handshake, for example "v0.0.8 znn-node". For the self entry it is the fixed placeholder "*self*".

StatsNetworkInfo.description: The node's current view of the p2p network, as returned by stats.networkInfo.

numPeers.description: Number of connected peers. It is sampled separately from peers, so it can momentarily differ from the length of that list.

self.description: The local node. Only its publicKey is real; ip and name hold the fixed placeholders "127.0.0.1" and "*self*".

StatsSyncInfo.description: Snapshot of the node's momentum synchronisation progress, as returned by stats.syncInfo (protocol.SyncInfo).

state.description: Sync state. 1 (Syncing) while currentHeight is behind targetHeight; 2 (SyncDone) once it has caught up; 3 (NotEnoughPeers) — overriding both — when fewer peers are connected than the node's configured minimum. 0 (Unknown) is the zero value and is never reported.

targetHeight.description: The frontier momentum height advertised by the best-known peer; 0 when no peers are connected.

SubscribeMomentumNotification.description: One element of a pushed payload of the momentums subscription (subscribe.toMomentums). It is the subscribe.Momentum Go type: the hash and height of a momentum just inserted into the chain (a momentum header reduced to its identity, NOT a full Momentum object). Each ledger.subscription notification for this stream carries a one-element array of these objects.

SubscribeAccountBlockNotification.description: One element of a pushed payload of the account-block subscriptions (subscribe.toAllAccountBlocks, subscribe.toAccountBlocksByAddress and subscribe.toUnreceivedAccountBlocksByAddress). It is the subscribe.AccountBlock Go type: a trimmed-down view of a committed account block (NOT the full AccountBlock object returned by the ledger query methods). Each ledger.subscription notification for these streams carries an array of these objects covering one momentum, with descendant blocks generated by embedded contracts flattened into the same array right after their parent.

blockType.description: Account block type; see the nom block-type constants. Send block types populate toAddress; receive block types populate fromHash.

address.description: Address of the account chain the block belongs to.

toAddress.description: Destination address of a send block. For the unreceivedAccountBlocksByAddress stream this is the subscribed address.

fromHash.description: Hash of the send block that a receive block accepts; the zero hash for blocks that are not receives.

Address.description: Zenon address in Bech32 form with human-readable part "z1". Embedded-contract addresses are fixed system addresses (for example the pillar contract z1qxemdeddedxpyllarxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxsy3fmg).

Hash.description: 32-byte SHA3-256 hash, hex encoded (64 lowercase hex characters).

HashHeight.description: Reference to a chain entry by hash and height. Used, among others, as an account block's momentumAcknowledged field, which anchors the block to a momentum the account had observed when the block was created.

TokenStandard.description: Zenon Token Standard (ZTS) identifier in Bech32 form with human-readable part "zts". ZNN is zts1znnxxxxxxxxxxxxx9z4ulx, QSR is zts1qsrxxxxxxxxxxxxxmrhjll; the zero token standard zts1qqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqtq587y marks blocks that move no tokens.

Amount.description: Arbitrary-precision unsigned integer amount, serialized as a base-10 JSON string to avoid precision loss. Amounts are expressed in raw base units of the token (no decimal scaling; 10^8 base units per ZNN or QSR).

Base64Bytes.description: Raw byte array, base64 encoded; empty string when the field is empty.

Nonce.description: 8-byte proof-of-work nonce, hex encoded; all zeros when no PoW was computed.

PageSize.description: Number of entries per page. Must be at most 1024 (RpcMaxPageSize) or the call fails with ErrPageSizeParamTooBig; some methods enforce stricter limits, documented per method.

PageParams.description: Documentation grouping of the 0-based pagination parameter pair used by paginated methods. The JSON-RPC API passes these as positional parameters, not as an object.

AccountHeader.description: Compact reference to one account block inside a momentum's content: the block's account address, hash and account-chain height.

address.description: Address whose account chain contains the referenced block.

hash.description: Hash of the referenced account block.

height.description: Account-chain height of the referenced account block.

MomentumHeader.description: Compact reference to a momentum: its hash, its momentum-chain height and its timestamp in Unix seconds.

AccountBlockConfirmationDetail.description: Describes the momentum that confirmed an account block.

numConfirmations.description: Number of momentums from the confirming momentum to the frontier, inclusive; 1 means the block was confirmed by the current frontier momentum.

momentumHeight.description: Height of the momentum that confirmed the block.

momentumHash.description: Hash of the momentum that confirmed the block.

momentumTimestamp.description: Timestamp of the confirming momentum, in Unix seconds.

TokenInfo.description: Description of an on-chain token (ZTS). Supplies are raw base units serialized as base-10 strings.

totalSupply.description: Circulating supply in raw base units, as a base-10 string.

decimals.description: Number of decimal places used to display raw base-unit amounts.

owner.description: Address allowed to mint and to change ownership.

maxSupply.description: Maximum mintable supply in raw base units, as a base-10 string.

BalanceInfo.description: One entry of AccountInfo.balanceInfoMap: a token description and the account's balance in that token.

balance.description: Balance in raw base units of the token (no decimal scaling), serialized as a base-10 JSON string.

AccountInfo.description: Summary of an account as returned by ledger.getAccountInfoByAddress.

accountHeight.description: Height of the account chain's frontier block, equal to the total number of blocks in the chain; 0 for an account with no blocks.

balanceInfoMap.description: Map from token standard (ZTS string) to token info and balance. Tokens for which no token info exists on chain are omitted.

AccountBlock.description: Wire form of a ledger account block: the core ledger fields enriched with data prefetched by the ledger API (token info, confirmation detail, paired block). big.Int amounts are serialized as base-10 JSON strings.

chainIdentifier.description: Network (chain) identifier the block was created for.

blockType.description: Block type: 1 genesis receive, 2 user send, 3 user receive, 4 contract send, 5 contract receive.

previousHash.description: Hash of the previous block in the same account chain.

height.description: Height of the block within its account chain; the first block has height 1.

momentumAcknowledged.description: Momentum the account had observed when the block was created.

address.description: Address of the account chain this block belongs to.

amount.description: Transferred amount in raw base units of tokenStandard, serialized as a base-10 JSON string (send information).

tokenStandard.description: ZTS of the transferred token; the zero token standard when the block moves no tokens (send information).

fromBlockHash.description: Hash of the send block being received; all zeros for send blocks (receive information).

descendantBlocks.description: Blocks generated while executing this block (batch information); empty for user blocks. Nested descendants are bare account blocks without the RPC-only extras (token, confirmationDetail, pairedAccountBlock).

data.description: Block payload (e.g. ABI-encoded embedded-contract call), base64 encoded.

difficulty.description: Proof-of-work difficulty; 0 when no PoW was used.

basePlasma.description: Smallest value of usedPlasma required for the block; not included in the hash.

usedPlasma.description: Total plasma consumed: fusedPlasma + PoW plasma; not included in the hash.

changesHash.description: Hash of the state changes produced by the block; not included in the hash.

publicKey.description: Ed25519 public key of the block signer, base64 encoded; null for contract-generated blocks. Not included in the hash.

signature.description: Ed25519 signature of the block hash, base64 encoded; null for contract-generated blocks. Not included in the hash.

token.description: Description of the token referenced by tokenStandard; null when the block moves no tokens.

confirmationDetail.description: Null while the block is not yet confirmed by a momentum.

pairedAccountBlock.description: Counterpart of this block: for a send block, the receive block that received it (null while unreceived); for a receive block, the originating send block. For a genesis-receive block, which has no real send counterpart, a synthetic empty contract-send block is fabricated, with confirmation detail anchored at the genesis momentum.

count.description: Total number of blocks available to the query that produced this list, not the length of list; see each ledger method for its exact meaning.

more.description: Whether additional blocks may exist beyond the window the producing method inspected; only ledger.getUnreceivedBlocksByAddress ever sets it to true.

Momentum.description: Wire form of a ledger momentum: the core ledger fields extended with the producer address, which is derived from the momentum's producer public key so clients do not have to recover it themselves.

height.description: Height in the momentum chain; the genesis momentum has height 1.

data.description: Momentum payload, base64 encoded; empty in practice.

content.description: References to the account blocks confirmed by this momentum.

changesHash.description: Hash of the state changes produced by the momentum.

publicKey.description: Ed25519 public key of the producing pillar, base64 encoded; not included in the hash.

signature.description: Ed25519 signature by the producing pillar, base64 encoded; not included in the hash.

producer.description: Pillar producer address, derived from publicKey.

count.description: Frontier momentum height at the time of the query (the total number of momentums in the chain), not the length of list.

DetailedMomentum.description: A momentum paired with the full account blocks it confirms, as returned by ledger.getDetailedMomentumsByHeight.

blocks.description: Full account blocks confirmed by the momentum.

DetailedMomentumList.description: Paginated list of momentums paired with the account blocks they confirm. count has the same meaning as in MomentumList.

count.description: Frontier momentum height at the time of the query.
